hypothesis: Flipping the weight of track_lin_vel_xy_exp from positive to negative penalizes forward movement, causing the policy to avoid locomotion, leading to negative total reward, increased base-contact terminations (falls), and degraded tracking performance.
expected_signature: Track_lin_vel_xy_exp reward becomes positive (similar to reference ~0.34), mean_reward recovers to reference levels, base_contact termination rate drops back to reference (~0.002), and episode length remains stable.
